title: PHP Settings
info_box: The settings you configure here are written into the PHP-FPM pool (php_admin_value/flag). Your site's .htaccess or .user.ini may still override them. PHP-FPM is restarted automatically on save — no downtime.
debug_desc_on: When on, PHP errors are printed to the screen and fatal errors are reliably captured and written to .gpanel/php_debug.log. Even if the application calls error_reporting(0), fatal errors are still captured.
debug_warning: ⚠️ When debug mode is on, display_errors and error_reporting = E_ALL are forced — error details may be visible to visitors. Enable only for troubleshooting and turn off on production. The change is applied after Save.
recent_errors_desc: Newest fatal errors on top. Source: /home/{sk}/.gpanel/php_debug.log (last 200 lines).
debug_log_empty: No recorded fatal errors yet. If one occurs, it will appear here.
debug_off_hint: Debug mode is off. Enable it above and save to start recording fatal errors.
modules_desc: {count} modules loaded for PHP {version}. Modules are server-wide — they cannot be toggled per domain.
disable_functions_desc: These functions introduce shell injection, RCE and malware risk. Category-based toggles are written to disable_functions. On = enabled (not blocked), Off = blocked.
extra_directives_desc: Define extra parameters using php.ini syntax. E.g.: extension=imagick.so
memory_limit_help: Maximum memory a script may allocate (bytes). E.g. 256M.
post_max_size_help: Maximum POST data size. Must be larger than upload_max.
display_errors_help: Print errors to output (keep off on production)
open_basedir_help: Directories PHP can access (empty = no limit). Separate with :
mail_force_extra_parameters_help: Extra parameters for the mail() function
pm_max_requests_help: Restart worker after this many requests (prevents memory leaks)
